description:
You are a platform engineer optimizing performance in a CI/CD pipeline. Your task is to monitor and analyze the recent pipeline execution logs for any slow steps and produce a summary report. 1. Locate the Jenkins pipeline log file at /home/user/cicd/logs/jenkins_pipeline.log. You do not need to modify this log file. 2. Identify all steps within this log file where the recorded execution time exceeds 5 seconds. Each step is logged in the following format:

Step: <step_name> | Started: <timestamp> | Ended: <timestamp> | Duration: <duration_in_seconds>

(for example:
Step: build | Started: 2024-06-05T10:01:44 | Ended: 2024-06-05T10:01:51 | Duration: 7) 3. For every step whose duration is above 5 seconds, create a summary file at /home/user/cicd/reports/slow_steps_report.txt that lists each slow step on a separate line in the following format:

<step_name>,<duration_in_seconds>

For example:
build,7
deploy,9

If there are no slow steps (duration ≤ 5 seconds), the summary file should contain exactly one line:
No slow steps detected

Make sure that your report is readable with cat and is in plain text format.
